Thank you for your interest in contributing to Lifeboat. We appreciate everyone who takes the time to improve this project.

Before you submit a pull request, it would help if you could take a moment to review what we have here. This will give you a good understanding of how the project works and what conventions we follow.

The project has tests in the tests folder and a GitHub Actions workflow that runs them automatically. We also use pre-commit hooks to check code quality before each commit. If you are adding new code, please try to match the style and patterns that already exist in the repository.

Documentation is always welcome. If something is unclear or could be explained better, feel free to improve it. The docs folder contains information about the API and how to get started quickly.

If you have any questions or are not sure about something, that is completely okay. You can still open an issue or pull request and we can discuss it together. We are happy to help newcomers and experienced contributors alike.

We ask that you remain respectful and considerate when interacting with others in this project. We all benefit from a friendly and supportive community.

Thank you again for your time and contributions. We look forward to seeing what you will add to Lifeboat.
